items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know him. I didn't know that much of him.

ctx.x: I think Lee was supposed to take Red's place, you know, and Red hadn't left the band when Lee showed up. One of them things, you know? So Lee is playing, you know, and not impressin' nobody. And Red comes walkin' in the place. So Red got up on the stand to blow some. Well, I mean, it was such a difference, night and day. Red knew what he was doing. And you know, Red was very arrogant anyway. He just knows he's the greatest. In other words, he was saying, "All right, down boy, down. I'll show you how it goes."…
Well, see, Lee Collins, he might have been a good trumpet player. I didn't know him. I didn't know that much of him. And for somebody to come right out of New Orleans
